1: 1  The client sends one JSON line over USB
2: 2  Core 0 checks it and queues a request for core 1
3: 3  Core 1 sets up the RF path for 1 GHz
4: 4  The RF wave travels to the cable, part of it is reflected
5: 5  The coupler samples the forward wave, then the reflected wave
6: 6  Raw codes go back to core 0 through the reply queue
7: 7  Core 0 turns the two codes into dB and applies the calibration
8: 8  One JSON line per point goes back to the client
9: …repeated for every frequency of the sweep: ≈ 2 ms per point
